newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai finance sector put on negative review - TRIS.
newsitem.headline: Thai finance sector put on negative review - TRIS.

text.p: Thai Rating and Information Services (TRIS) said on Wednesday it is reviewing with negative implications its ratings of institutions in the Thai financial industry.

TRIS said Thai financial institutions have in the past few years faced a tougher operating environment due to a downturn of the Thai securities sector, intense competition in finance business, economic slowdown, and strict monetary measures of the Bank of Thailand.
TRIS said the more challenging situation facing the industry has adversely affected financial institutions in different degrees depending on their business structure and fundamentals.
"The BOT's stricter prudential requirements, such as newly imposed reserves on substandard-classifed assets, should strengthen industry stability over the long term.
"However, current difficulties in the system, particularly liquidity and earnings pressure, have raised concerns over the shorter term financial profile of the industry," it said.
TRIS said increased non-performing loans and depreciating assets have hurt earnings of finance firms and their equity base because of required provisions for doubtful debt.
"TRIS will review the industry fundamentals and magnitude of system risk to determine how these will impact the ratings," it said.
